decisions.reason: Actual expression repair compared to exact source. The requested expression correction has not happened: image1 still has sharply down-slanting angry eyebrows and a stern closed mouth, whereas image2 has a mild smile with gently lifted mouth corners and relaxed brows. Redraw the face with that actual gentle smile and relaxed original brow direction. Remove the angry scowl. Keep a small natural mascot mouth and avoid an exaggerated grin. Source expression, head angle and gaze are the authority. Preserve all unrelated receding dark hair, smooth face, actual coat, pale shirt/blue tie, source crop/illumination, photo frame, overlapping paper and genuine exterior alpha.
